name: Contemporary High-Integrity Neubrutalism
designThesis: Playful yet disciplined contemporary neubrutalism combining bold solid black borders, hard offset drop shadows, vibrant high-contrast color blocks, and retro-modern typography, engineered with strict CSS logical properties and zero layout shift.
bestFitContexts: Developer tools, documentation, and open-source landing pages
Modern creative agency and portfolio presentations
Creator economy, newsletter, and digital product marketplaces
Startup marketing pages seeking distinctive visual character
poorFitContexts: Clinical hospital patient records and medical charting

colorStrategy.canvasTone: Warm tinted cream (#FFFDF9) in light; Dark Charcoal (#18181B) in dark
colorStrategy.accentUsage: Vibrant primary blocks (Electric Yellow #FACC15, Neon Lime #84CC16, Punchy Pink #EC4899) framed by solid black borders
colorStrategy.contrastTarget: Minimum 7.0:1 AAA contrast for all text and UI boundaries

typographyStrategy.fontPairing: Space Grotesk or Syne for bold headlines, DM Sans or Inter for body text
typographyStrategy.hierarchyEmphasis: Heavy bold display weights (800+) with tight tracking and high impact

layoutRhythm.gridStructure: Asymmetric bento grid with visible thick structural borders
layoutRhythm.whitespaceDiscipline: Bold 24px and 32px block gaps with intentional physical weight

surfaceTreatment.radius: 4px to 6px subtle rounding (maintains crisp structural edge)
surfaceTreatment.depthElevation: Hard offset box-shadows (e.g., 4px 4px 0px #000000) with zero blur

componentGuidelines.primaryActionStyle: High-contrast block button with 3px solid border and 4px offset shadow translating to 0px on press
componentGuidelines.cardStructure: Solid cards with thick borders, bright accent badge pills, and crisp dividers
componentGuidelines.tablePresentation: Thick-bordered grid cells with contrasting alternating header backgrounds

accessibilityProfile.keyboardHandling: Ultra-visible high-contrast focus outline with 3px black/white offset
accessibilityProfile.reducedMotionRules: Press translation physics replaced with instantaneous color shift

antiPatterns: Soft fuzzy drop shadows mixed with brutalist borders
Low-contrast pastel borders that fail non-text contrast guidelines
Over-rotated tilted elements causing layout shift or reading fatigue
Inconsistent border widths varying between 1px and 5px arbitrarily

browserChecks: Verify hard offset box-shadow translation on interactive buttons
Verify thick border contrast and layout reflow
Verify RTL symmetry on directional button arrows
